title: Diplomacy and Deception From North Korea

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约

sentences.en: Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: President Trump says the nuclear threat from North Korea is over.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统称来自朝鲜的核威胁已经结束。

sentences.en: New reporting by The Times suggests the situation has only worsened since his summit meeting with Kim Jong-un back in June.
sentences.zh: 但《纽约时报》的最新报道显示，自今年6月他与金正恩举行峰会以来，局势非但没有好转，反而恶化了。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, November 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月13日，星期二。

sentences.en: A few months ago, North Korean experts at a think tank in Washington started asking themselves the question, what else could the North Koreans have out there?
sentences.zh: 几个月前，华盛顿一家智库的朝鲜问题专家开始问自己一个问题：朝鲜人手里还有什么？

sentences.en: David Sanger is a national security correspondent for The Times.
sentences.zh: 大卫·桑格是《纽约时报》的国家安全记者。

sentences.en: There are a lot of nuclear sites that we've known about in North Korea for a long time.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，我们一直知道朝鲜有很多核设施。

sentences.en: There are a lot that have been rumored.
sentences.zh: 也有很多关于核设施的传闻。

sentences.en: But the big question is, what do the North Koreans really have and is it changing?
sentences.zh: 但最大的问题是，朝鲜人到底拥有什么？情况在发生变化吗？

sentences.en: So at the think tank, a man named Victor Cha began to think about a project to go figure out where all of the North's nuclear and missile facilities were.
sentences.zh: 于是，在智库里，一个叫维克多·车的人开始构思一个项目，去查明朝鲜所有的核设施和导弹设施都在哪里。

sentences.en: They began to assemble very detailed satellite photographs and compare those to every report they've had over the past 30, 35 years of possible North Korean facilities.
sentences.zh: 他们开始收集非常详细的卫星照片，并将这些照片与过去30到35年间关于朝鲜可能存在的设施的所有报告进行比对。

sentences.en: These came from defectors.
sentences.zh: 这些信息来自脱北者。

sentences.en: Sometimes they came from previous, older, not very good satellite photographs, and they moved
sentences.zh: 有时来自以前那些质量不太好的旧卫星照片，他们按部就班地

sentences.en: methodically across the country, quadrant by quadrant, looking for the telltale signs of missile bases.
sentences.zh: 对全国进行逐个象限的搜寻，寻找导弹基地的蛛丝马迹。

sentences.en: Usually, you can see tunnel entrances on the sides of mountains.
sentences.zh: 通常，你可以看到山腰上的隧道入口。

sentences.en: You can see special driveways that are large enough to carry these enormous mobile launchers where a missile is pulled out of a tunnel in the mountain
sentences.zh: 你可以看到足够宽的专用车道，足以容纳那些巨大的移动发射车，导弹从山里的隧道中被拉出来，

sentences.en: and driven out to a road and can be set up to be launched.
sentences.zh: 开到路上，然后架设起来准备发射。

sentences.en: They see certain kinds of outbuildings.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了某些类型的附属建筑。

sentences.en: And they were just looking for the patterns to find out how many of these there were.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在寻找规律，以查明到底有多少这样的设施。

sentences.en: So what did they find?
sentences.zh: 那么他们发现了什么？

sentences.en: Michael, what they found were 16 different sites, each one of them with those telltale tunnel entrances,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，他们发现了16个不同的地点，每一个都有那些标志性的隧道入口、

sentences.en: the outbuildings, everything that you would need in order to have a well-protected missile site.
sentences.zh: 附属建筑，以及拥有一个防御良好的导弹基地所需的一切。

sentences.en: And one of those sites looked like it was being upgraded to house missiles that were designed to reach the United States.
sentences.zh: 其中一个地点看起来正在升级，以容纳旨在打击美国的导弹。

sentences.en: Now, we don't know if the North Koreans actually can deliver a nuclear weapon on Los Angeles or Washington or New York, but certainly they're working in that direction.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们不知道朝鲜是否真的有能力用核武器攻击洛杉矶、华盛顿或纽约，但他们无疑正朝着这个方向努力。

sentences.en: And David, when you say upgraded, what does that mean when it comes to a missile site?
sentences.zh: 大卫，当你提到“升级”时，对于一个导弹基地来说意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, it can mean any of a number of things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可能意味着很多事情。

sentences.en: It can mean that the outbuildings are getting more sophisticated.
sentences.zh: 可能意味着附属建筑变得更加先进了。

sentences.en: It can mean that they're building better roads and other facilities just outside the tunnels
sentences.zh: 可能意味着他们在隧道外修建了更好的道路和其他设施，

sentences.en: so that they can rapidly deploy the missile, set it up, and set it to launch right away.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就能迅速部署导弹、架设并立即发射。

sentences.en: In the North Korean view, speed is of the essence.
sentences.zh: 在朝鲜看来，速度至关重要。

sentences.en: The faster they could bring a mobile missile launcher out and set it up, the less time the United States would have to conduct a preemptive strike.
sentences.zh: 他们越快地把移动导弹发射车拉出来并架设好，美国进行先发制人打击的时间就越少。

sentences.en: And what does it mean that all these missile bases have been discovered in this moment?
sentences.zh: 在这个时候发现所有这些导弹基地意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, what it means, Michael, is that a great deception may be going on, or at least a pretty sophisticated shell game,
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，这意味着可能正在进行一场巨大的欺骗，或者至少是一场相当复杂的骗局，

sentences.en: in which the North Koreans are declaring that they are complying with that agreement that they struck with President Trump in Singapore five months ago,
sentences.zh: 朝鲜一方面声称他们正在遵守五个月前在新加坡与特朗普总统达成的协议，

sentences.en: when in fact what they're doing is improving or rebuilding facilities faster than they are dismantling a few old ones.
sentences.zh: 而实际上他们拆除少数旧设施的速度，远赶不上他们改进或重建设施的速度。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And take me back to that agreement.
sentences.zh: 带我回顾一下那个协议。

sentences.en: What was the expectation of what North Korea would do?
sentences.zh: 当时对朝鲜的期望是什么？

sentences.en: There's the president of the United States stepping out, waving as he lands in Singapore, ahead of this historic summit with Kim Jong-un.
sentences.zh: 那是美国总统走下飞机，在新加坡着陆时挥手致意，准备与金正恩举行历史性峰会。

sentences.en: Well, remember, Michael, this was June 12th in Singapore, and the entire city came to a complete stop.
sentences.zh: 嗯，记住，迈克尔，那是6月12日的新加坡，整个城市完全停摆了。

sentences.en: Probably the biggest diplomatic event for North Korea in a very long time, since the Korean War, maybe.
sentences.zh: 这可能是朝鲜自朝鲜战争以来最重大的外交事件，也许是这样。

sentences.en: Because here you had the first meeting between an American president and one of North Korea's dictators.
sentences.zh: 因为这是美国总统与朝鲜独裁者之间的首次会晤。

sentences.en: An enormous test of the president of the United States and his ability to motivate and to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 这对美国总统及其激励和谈判的能力是一次巨大的考验。

sentences.en: Donald Trump had done something no other president had ever done, which was agree to sit down with a North Korean leader one-on-one.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普做了一件其他总统从未做过的事，那就是同意与朝鲜领导人进行一对一会谈。

sentences.en: He didn't feel that he needed to prepare because he said he had been preparing all his life for this.
sentences.zh: 他觉得不需要准备，因为他说他一生都在为这一刻做准备。

sentences.en: That is what worries people.
sentences.zh: 这正是人们担心的地方。

sentences.en: If the president is going to go and sit down and he doesn't have a concrete list of what he wants to walk away with...
sentences.zh: 如果总统去参加会谈，却没有一个具体的清单，不知道自己想要达成什么……

sentences.en: And he announced that he was doing it because he was such a great negotiator that he knew that he could reach an agreement himself.
sentences.zh: 他宣布这样做是因为他是一位伟大的谈判家，他知道自己可以亲自达成协议。

sentences.en: How long do you think it would take you to figure out whether he's serious about giving out...
sentences.zh: 你认为需要多久才能判断他是否真的想放弃……

sentences.en: It's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: How long would it take?
sentences.zh: 需要多久？

sentences.en: I think within the first minute, I'll know.
sentences.zh: 我想第一分钟内我就能知道。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么知道？

sentences.en: Just my touch, my feel.
sentences.zh: 凭我的直觉，我的感觉。

sentences.en: That's what I do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的做事方式。

sentences.en: And frankly, it made a lot of sense, Michael, because for years we have been arguing with the North Koreans but not talking to the right person.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，迈克尔，这很有道理，因为多年来我们一直在与朝鲜争论，但没有与对的人交谈。

sentences.en: You know the way they say that you know if you're going to like somebody in the first five seconds?
sentences.zh: 你知道人们常说，你能在前五秒钟就知道自己是否会喜欢某个人吗？

sentences.en: You ever hear that one?
sentences.zh: 你听说过这个说法吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think that very quickly I'll know whether or not
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我很快就能知道

sentences.en: something good is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 是否会有好的结果发生。

sentences.en: You know, North Korea is run by a single dictator, and if the agreement wasn't with the dictator but with his minions, it didn't mean much.
sentences.zh: 你知道，朝鲜是由一位独裁者统治的，如果协议不是与独裁者达成的，而是与他的爪牙达成的，那就没什么意义。

sentences.en: So the president had the right thought,
sentences.zh: 所以总统的想法是对的，

sentences.en: and when they finally met...
sentences.zh: 当他们最终会面时……

sentences.en: So we're signing a very important document.
sentences.zh: 我们正在签署一份非常重要的文件。

sentences.en: They agreed on a piece of paper...
sentences.zh: 他们在纸上达成了一致……

sentences.en: Pretty comprehensive document.
sentences.zh: 相当全面的文件。

sentences.en: ...that laid out in very vague terms what each country would go do.
sentences.zh: ……以非常模糊的措辞列出了每个国家将要做的事情。

sentences.en: And we've had a really great term together, a great relationship.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起度过了一段非常美好的时光，建立了良好的关系。

sentences.en: And the problem with it was it wasn't a very specific document.
sentences.zh: 它的问题在于它不是一份非常具体的文件。

sentences.en: And so everybody emerged from this thinking it said as something slightly different.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人从中得出的结论都略有不同。

sentences.en: I would like to express my gratitude to President Trump to make this meeting happen.
sentences.zh: 我想向特朗普总统表达我的谢意，感谢他促成了这次会晤。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: What did the North Koreans think they had agreed to?
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人认为他们达成了什么协议？

sentences.en: So the North Koreans thought that they had agreed to the United States reducing the level of tensions,
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人认为他们达成的协议是美国降低紧张局势，

sentences.en: formally declaring an end to the Korean War.
sentences.zh: 正式宣布结束朝鲜战争。

sentences.en: They thought that the United States would agree to begin, over time, lifting the sanctions and the embargoes on North Korea, building up truSt.
sentences.zh: 他们认为美国会同意随着时间的推移，开始解除对朝鲜的制裁和禁运，建立信任。

sentences.en: And then ultimately, that would reduce the need for them to have nuclear weapons to defend themselves.
sentences.zh: 最终，这将减少他们拥有核武器来保卫自己的必要性。

sentences.en: The United States thought they had agreed to something in just the opposite order, that the North Koreans would denuclearize, they would get rid of their missiles.
sentences.zh: 美国认为他们达成的协议顺序恰恰相反，即朝鲜将实现无核化，他们将销毁导弹。

sentences.en: And when that was all done, and only when that was all done, would the sanctions begin to go away and would North Korea be treated like a normal nation?
sentences.zh: 当这一切完成后，只有在这一切完成后，制裁才会开始取消，朝鲜才会像一个正常国家一样被对待。

sentences.en: So they almost had mirror images of this agreement.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对这份协议的理解几乎是镜像的。

sentences.en: And it was such a rushed job because both Kim Jong-un and President Trump wanted to get this meeting going for their own reasons, have the photo op,
sentences.zh: 这是一项非常仓促的工作，因为金正恩和特朗普总统都出于各自的原因想要促成这次会晤，进行拍照留念，

sentences.en: that no one really sorted out the question of in what order would each of these steps come?
sentences.zh: 以至于没有人真正理清这些步骤的先后顺序。

sentences.en: What would have to happen before the next thing happened?
sentences.zh: 在下一步发生之前必须发生什么？

sentences.en: Our unprecedented meeting, the first between an American president and a leader of North Korea,
sentences.zh: 我们史无前例的会晤，美国总统与朝鲜领导人的首次会晤，

sentences.en: proves that real change is indeed possible.
sentences.zh: 证明真正的改变确实是可能的。

sentences.en: My meeting with Chairman Kim was honest, direct, and productive.
sentences.zh: 我与金委员长的会晤是诚实、直接且富有成效的。

sentences.en: We got to know each other well in a very confined period of time under very strong, strong circumstance.
sentences.zh: 我们在非常有限的时间内，在非常强烈的环境下，很好地了解了彼此。

sentences.en: So they signed the same agreement, David, but took entirely different meanings from it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们签署了同一份协议，大卫，但从中解读出了完全不同的含义。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It's really hard to fathom two countries agreeing to something so fundamentally different.
sentences.zh: 真的很难想象两个国家会对如此根本不同的事情达成一致。

sentences.en: I mean, the word agreement doesn't even seem to apply to this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，“协议”这个词甚至似乎都不适用于此。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it was an incredibly poorly, sloppily written document.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一份写得极其糟糕、草率的文件。

sentences.en: And it was sloppily written precisely because both sides knew that the more specific it got, the less likely it was either side could agree to it.
sentences.zh: 它之所以写得草率，正是因为双方都知道，内容越具体，双方达成一致的可能性就越小。

sentences.en: And did this agreement, however vague, have any timeline?
sentences.zh: 那么这份协议，无论多么模糊，有时间表吗？

sentences.en: It had no timeline in it.
sentences.zh: 里面没有任何时间表。

sentences.en: And that was one of its several flaws.
sentences.zh: 这是它几个缺陷之一。

sentences.en: It did not create a time pressure.
sentences.zh: 它没有制造时间压力。

sentences.en: And then President Trump did something that in many ways took the pressure off the North Koreans.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普总统做了一件事，在很多方面减轻了朝鲜人的压力。

sentences.en: He got out of Singapore.
sentences.zh: 他离开了新加坡。

sentences.en: And as he landed in the United States, he reached for his phone and he tweeted,
sentences.zh: 当他抵达美国时，他拿出手机发了推文，

sentences.en: Just landed, a long trip, but everybody can now feel much safer than the day I took office.
sentences.zh: 刚落地，长途旅行，但现在每个人都可以比我上任那天感到更安全了。

sentences.en: Goes on to say that there's no longer nuclear threat from North Korea.
sentences.zh: 接着说来自朝鲜的核威胁已不复存在。

sentences.en: And he says that the meeting with Kim Jong-un was very interesting and very positive.
sentences.zh: 他说与金正恩的会晤非常有趣且非常积极。

sentences.en: And he was tweeting an emotion, as one of his aides later said to me.
sentences.zh: 正如他的一位助手后来告诉我的，他是在发推文表达一种情绪。

sentences.en: He felt like because they had a pretty good rapport, because they could get along as sort of business partners, that that's what the threat was all about.
sentences.zh: 他觉得因为他们建立了相当好的融洽关系，因为他们可以像商业伙伴一样相处，所以这就是威胁的全部含义。

sentences.en: And part of the threat is about an intent.
sentences.zh: 而威胁的一部分是关于意图。

sentences.en: He didn't think that Kim Jong-un was about to go attack the United States.
sentences.zh: 他不认为金正恩即将攻击美国。

sentences.en: And therefore, we didn't have a threat.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们没有威胁。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is that the nuclear infrastructure in North Korea was exactly the same the day after they met in Singapore as it was the day before.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，朝鲜的核基础设施在他们新加坡会晤后的第二天，与会晤前一天完全一样。

sentences.en: So five months later, what from that agreement has actually been accomplished on both sides?
sentences.zh: 那么五个月后，那份协议中双方实际上完成了什么？

sentences.en: Almost nothing.
sentences.zh: 几乎什么都没有。

sentences.en: Think of it.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: We got our hostages back.
sentences.zh: 我们找回了人质。

sentences.en: We got our hostages back.
sentences.zh: 我们找回了人质。

sentences.en: The president talks about the fact that North Korea returned some hostages.
sentences.zh: 总统谈到了朝鲜归还了一些人质的事实。

sentences.en: And we have a good relationship with Kim Jong-un.
sentences.zh: 我们与金正恩关系良好。

sentences.en: We have a great relationship with Chairman Kim, and we feel good about it.
sentences.zh: 我们与金委员长关系很好，我们对此感觉良好。

sentences.en: It's wonderful they got out.
sentences.zh: 他们能回来真是太好了。

sentences.en: It has nothing to do with the nuclear program, right?
sentences.zh: 但这与核计划无关，对吧？

sentences.en: The North Koreans said they would dismantle some facilities.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人说他们会拆除一些设施。

sentences.en: They haven't finished dismantling them.
sentences.zh: 他们还没有拆除完毕。

sentences.en: They said they would allow in inspectors.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们会允许检查人员进入。

sentences.en: It may happen, but it hasn't happened yet.
sentences.zh: 这可能会发生，但目前还没有发生。

sentences.en: And they never committed to, and President Trump never insisted upon, the most fundamental part of any one of these agreements, which is a nuclear freeze and a missile freeze,
sentences.zh: 而且他们从未承诺，特朗普总统也从未坚持过任何此类协议中最根本的部分，即核冻结和导弹冻结，

sentences.en: so that while the agreement was playing out, the North Koreans would have to demonstrate that they are no longer making nuclear fuel,
sentences.zh: 这样在协议执行期间，朝鲜必须证明他们不再制造核燃料、

sentences.en: making nuclear weapons, and making new missiles, or improving these missile sites.
sentences.zh: 制造核武器、制造新导弹，或者改进这些导弹基地。

sentences.en: If there had been a freeze as a first step, then you'd say, okay, then you've got time because the situation isn't getting worse.
sentences.zh: 如果第一步是冻结，那么你会说，好吧，那你有时间，因为局势没有恶化。

sentences.en: But President Trump couldn't get that.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统没能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the North Koreans say, hey, what about that peace agreement that President Trump said that he would be perfectly willing to go along and sign?
sentences.zh: 与此同时，朝鲜人说，嘿，特朗普总统说他完全愿意签署的那份和平协议怎么样了？

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美国

sentences.en: has said, we're not doing a peace agreement until we're beginning to go down the road to denuclearization.
sentences.zh: 表示，在我们开始走上无核化道路之前，我们不会签署和平协议。

sentences.en: And so, as a result, the United States and North Korea are at great loggerheads.
sentences.zh: 因此，结果是美国和朝鲜陷入了严重的僵局。

sentences.en: David, what you've laid out does not at all sound like meaningful progress from either side, but that is not how President Trump has described the state of these negotiations.
sentences.zh: 大卫，你所陈述的情况听起来根本不像双方取得了有意义的进展，但这并不是特朗普总统描述这些谈判状态的方式。

sentences.en: It certainly isn't how the president has described it because he's only told Americans half the story.
sentences.zh: 这当然不是总统描述它的方式，因为他只告诉了美国人一半的故事。

sentences.en: They're destroying their engine site.
sentences.zh: 他们正在摧毁他们的发动机试验场。

sentences.en: They're blowing it up.
sentences.zh: 他们正在炸毁它。

sentences.en: They've already blown up one of their big test sites.
sentences.zh: 他们已经炸毁了他们的一处大型试验场。

sentences.en: He has touted the fact that the North Koreans have taken apart at least one big missile test facility.
sentences.zh: 他曾大肆宣扬朝鲜已经拆除了至少一处大型导弹试验设施的事实。

sentences.en: In fact, it was actually four of their big test sites.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那其实是他们的四个大型试验场。

sentences.en: And the big thing is it will be a total denuclearization, which is already starting to take place.
sentences.zh: 最重要的一点是，这将是彻底的无核化，而且已经开始进行了。

sentences.en: They've made a big deal of the fact that the North Koreans blew up the entrances to one of their big nuclear test sites.
sentences.zh: 他们大张旗鼓地宣扬朝鲜炸毁了其一处核试验场的入口。

sentences.en: But the relationship that Mike has and I have with Chairman Kim and his group
sentences.zh: 但迈克和我与金委员长及其团队之间的关系

sentences.en: is a very good one, very strong one, and I think it's going to lead to tremendous success.
sentences.zh: 非常好，非常稳固，我认为这将带来巨大的成功。

sentences.en: But the document we signed...
sentences.zh: 但我们签署的文件……

sentences.en: These are all described to Americans in an effort by President Trump to make the case that his diplomacy with Kim Jong-un is working.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统向美国人描述这一切，是为了证明他与金正恩的外交正在发挥作用。

sentences.en: And the North Koreans, bit by bit, grudgingly, slowly, are moving toward denuclearization.
sentences.zh: 而朝鲜人正一点一点、勉强地、缓慢地朝着无核化迈进。

sentences.en: When you look at the bigger picture, when you open up that satellite aperture and really look across the country, what you discover is they're closing down a few sites
sentences.zh: 当你着眼于大局，当你打开卫星孔径真正审视整个国家时，你会发现他们正在关闭几个地点

sentences.en: to make President Trump happy.
sentences.zh: 来取悦特朗普总统。

sentences.en: And they're expanding many others.
sentences.zh: 而他们正在扩建许多其他地点。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙。

sentences.en: To see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So to that point, David, I have to imagine that in doing this reporting, you went to the Trump administration and said, we have discovered evidence of these 16 secret bases
sentences.zh: 所以说到这一点，大卫，我不得不设想，在进行这项报道时，你曾找到特朗普政府说，我们发现了这16个秘密基地的证据

sentences.en: where missiles are being developed.
sentences.zh: 这些基地正在研发导弹。

sentences.en: Missiles that could potentially reach, hurt the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些导弹可能触及并伤害美国

sentences.en: and its allies.
sentences.zh: 及其盟友。

sentences.en: And I wonder, given what you've just said, what the reaction from the Trump White House was when you did that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，鉴于你刚才所说的，当你这样做时，特朗普白宫的反应是什么。

sentences.en: Well, you know, with this White House, frequently the reaction is no reaction, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，对于这届白宫，通常的反应就是没有反应，对吧？

sentences.en: I did go to them and I went to both the State Department and the intelligence agencies and described this.
sentences.zh: 我的确找过他们，我去了国务院和情报机构，并描述了这些情况。

sentences.en: And in off-the-record conversations, people said to me, look, there are no facilities in this unclassified report that we don't already know about.
sentences.zh: 在非正式谈话中，人们对我说，看，这份非机密报告中没有任何我们不知道的设施。

sentences.en: Of course, we've seen all these.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们都见过这些。

sentences.en: North Korea is the most studied piece of real estate on Earth.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜是地球上被研究得最透彻的一块土地。

sentences.en: It's mapped by everybody.
sentences.zh: 每个人都对它进行了测绘。

sentences.en: So they weren't surprised by this.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对此并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: They were just uncomfortable that all this was becoming clear because of good analysis of unclassified commercial photography.
sentences.zh: 他们只是感到不安，因为通过对非机密商业摄影的良好分析，这一切变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: So their greatest discomfort was the fact that you were going to alert the public, not necessarily that these 16 bases exiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最大的不安在于你要提醒公众，而不一定是因为这16个基地的存在。

sentences.en: They've known about these bases for a long time and presumably they've known about the improvements.
sentences.zh: 他们早就知道这些基地，而且想必他们也知道这些改进。

sentences.en: They wouldn't discuss the bases with me because they look at them through classified satellite imagery.
sentences.zh: 他们不会和我讨论这些基地，因为他们是通过机密卫星图像来看待它们的。

sentences.en: So they say, we can't discuss it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，我们不能讨论它。

sentences.en: It's classified.
sentences.zh: 这是机密的。

sentences.en: David, when it comes to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 大卫，当涉及到美国

sentences.en: essentially keeping these kinds of bases in North Korea hidden until you unearth them.
sentences.zh: 基本上是在你挖掘出来之前，将这类基地隐藏在朝鲜。

sentences.en: I guess I'm kind of confused about why the Trump administration feels it's in America's best interest to proclaim that these negotiations with North Korea are going well
sentences.zh: 我想我有点困惑，为什么特朗普政府认为宣称与朝鲜的这些谈判进展顺利符合美国的最佳利益

sentences.en: when in fact, based on everything that you have told us, they are in fact going in the opposite direction of what we want.
sentences.zh: 而事实上，根据你告诉我们的一切，它们实际上正朝着我们想要的方向的反面发展。

sentences.en: They're not just not going well.
sentences.zh: 它们不仅仅是不顺利。

sentences.en: They're going in reverse and quite poorly.
sentences.zh: 它们正在倒退，而且非常糟糕。

sentences.en: Why wouldn't the White House just want to fess up about that fact?
sentences.zh: 为什么白宫不想承认这个事实呢？

sentences.en: Because it's wrapped up in the president's own image of himself as the world's greatest negotiator.
sentences.zh: 因为这与总统将自己视为世界上最伟大的谈判者的形象紧密相连。

sentences.en: The man who can reach out and sit down with another leader, in this case, a dictator, an incredibly brutal leader who has got gulags full of dissidents back in his country,
sentences.zh: 这个男人可以接触并与另一位领导人坐下来谈，在这种情况下，是一位独裁者，一位极其残暴的领导人，他的国家里关满了异见人士的古拉格集中营，

sentences.en: but that the president feels like the only thing that makes a difference is the deal that he personally can strike.
sentences.zh: 但总统觉得唯一能产生影响的就是他个人能达成的交易。

sentences.en: And the thought that kept playing out in the back of my mind was this.
sentences.zh: 而我脑海中不断浮现的一个想法是这样的。

sentences.en: Are the North Koreans really deceiving us?
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人真的在欺骗我们吗？

sentences.en: Because after all,
sentences.zh: 因为毕竟，

sentences.en: American intelligence agencies know about every one of these facilities.
sentences.zh: 美国情报机构知道每一个这样的设施。

sentences.en: Or are we deceiving ourselves?
sentences.zh: 还是我们在欺骗自己？

sentences.en: Or is the Trump administration deceiving itself?
sentences.zh: 或者是特朗普政府在欺骗自己？

sentences.en: Ignoring the evidence of what's going on elsewhere in the country in its quest to prove that its singular diplomacy with the North has been successful.
sentences.zh: 为了证明其与朝鲜的独特外交取得了成功，而无视该国其他地方正在发生什么的证据。

sentences.en: And maybe it will be successful, Michael, and we all certainly hope it will be.
sentences.zh: 也许它会成功，迈克尔，我们当然都希望它会成功。

sentences.en: But the early evidence suggests that this administration doesn't want to hear about contrary intelligence that suggests the North Koreans are playing a giant shell game with them.
sentences.zh: 但早期证据表明，这届政府不想听到相反的情报，这些情报暗示朝鲜人正在与他们玩一场巨大的壳游戏。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And David, what is your conclusion?
sentences.zh: 那么大卫，你的结论是什么？

sentences.en: Who is deceiving whom here?
sentences.zh: 这里到底是谁在欺骗谁？

sentences.en: In this agreement, Michael, I think everyone's deceiving everyone else.
sentences.zh: 在这项协议中，迈克尔，我认为每个人都在欺骗其他人。

sentences.en: The North Koreans are deceiving us about what kind of facilities they're secretly keeping going even while they dismantle some.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人在欺骗我们，关于他们即使在拆除一些设施的同时，还在秘密维持什么样的设施。

sentences.en: The Americans are deceiving themselves about how quickly and how sincerely the North Koreans will go about denuclearization because their intent on showing that the president's
sentences.zh: 美国人在欺骗自己，关于朝鲜人将以多快、多诚恳的态度进行无核化，因为他们执意要展示总统的

sentences.en: one-on-one diplomacy worked.
sentences.zh: 一对一外交奏效了。

sentences.en: And the rest of the world may be averting its eyes from both the truth of what's happening in North Korea and what the administration is saying about it
sentences.zh: 而世界其他地方可能正在回避真相，既回避朝鲜正在发生的事情的真相，也回避政府对此的说法

sentences.en: because they fear going back to the summer of 2017 when President Trump was still talking about fire and fury like the world has never seen and seemed about to attack
sentences.zh: 因为他们害怕回到2017年的夏天，当时特朗普总统还在谈论世界从未见过的烈火与愤怒，似乎即将攻击

sentences.en: the North Koreans.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人。

sentences.en: So what is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么美国

sentences.en: doing or planning to do about those 16 missile bases that the North Korean experts discovered and that you reported?
sentences.zh: 正在或计划对朝鲜专家发现且你报道的那16个导弹基地做些什么？

sentences.en: Does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: have any plan to try to force North Korea to dismantle these?
sentences.zh: 有什么计划试图强迫朝鲜拆除这些基地吗？

sentences.en: Well, you know, Michael, one of the problems that President Trump is facing right now is that the way that he handled these negotiations, declaring success after the first meeting,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，迈克尔，特朗普总统现在面临的问题之一是，他处理这些谈判的方式，在第一次会议后就宣布成功，

sentences.en: is that his leverage is crumbling.
sentences.zh: 导致他的筹码正在瓦解。

sentences.en: The sanctions that the United States built up over the years have begun to disappear because the Russians and the Chinese say there's a new and better tone
sentences.zh: 美国多年来建立的制裁已经开始消失，因为俄罗斯人和中国人说现在有了新的、更好的基调，

sentences.en: and even the South Koreans have broken away from the United States on the question of how much they should deal with North Korea.
sentences.zh: 甚至连韩国人在应该与朝鲜打交道到什么程度的问题上也已经与美国分道扬镳了。

sentences.en: So the president's lost a huge amount of his economic leverage and what makes the problem even harder, Michael, is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以总统失去了大量的经济筹码，而让问题变得更难的是，迈克尔，美国

sentences.en: doesn't have very good constant eyes on the North Korean missile program.
sentences.zh: 并没有很好地持续关注朝鲜的导弹计划。

sentences.en: We have these big
sentences.zh: 我们有这些巨大的

sentences.en: $5 billion satellites that only pass over
sentences.zh: 50亿美元的卫星，它们只是周期性地经过

sentences.en: North Korea periodically.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜上空。

sentences.en: So if they rolled out one of these missiles from a launch site, you might not see it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们从发射场推出其中一枚导弹，你可能根本看不到。

sentences.en: And because he appears to have done a 180-degree turn from the summer of 2017, people don't believe he's terribly eager to use military force either.
sentences.zh: 而且因为他似乎已经从2017年夏天做了一百八十度的大转弯，人们也不相信他非常渴望使用军事力量。

sentences.en: And while it may be a very good thing he's not planning to go use military force, if you're the North Koreans, the pressure has suddenly come off after many, many years.
sentences.zh: 虽然他没打算使用军事力量可能是一件好事，但如果你是朝鲜人，在经历了许多许多年之后，压力突然消失了。

sentences.en: So President Trump, in his effort to demonstrate that he's a skilled negotiator, has basically negotiated away his main points of leverage.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普总统为了证明自己是一位熟练的谈判者，基本上把他的主要筹码都谈没了。

sentences.en: And it's likely that despite whatever danger these bases may pose,
sentences.zh: 而且很可能，尽管这些基地可能构成任何危险，

sentences.en: North Korea will be allowed to maintain and improve them.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜仍将被允许维持和改进它们。

sentences.en: And there will be no repercussions.
sentences.zh: 而且不会有任何后果。

sentences.en: If I took the State Department statement literally, the North Koreans could keep the bases but would have to lose all the missiles that are on them.
sentences.zh: 如果我从字面上理解国务院的声明，朝鲜人可以保留这些基地，但必须失去基地上的所有导弹。

sentences.en: I don't think that's very likely to happen in the near future.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这在不久的将来很有可能发生。

sentences.en: And more importantly, neither do the North Koreans.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，朝鲜人也不这么认为。

sentences.en: David, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Great to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴和你在一起。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: This is truly a tragedy that all Californians
sentences.zh: 这确实是一场所有加州人

sentences.en: can understand and respond to and be very sympathetic.
sentences.zh: 都能理解、回应并深表同情的悲剧。

sentences.en: The wildfires in both northern and southern California continue to rage with strong winds whipping the fires across thousands of acres of forest and brush.
sentences.zh: 北加州和南加州的野火继续肆虐，强风将火势吹向数千英亩的森林和灌木丛。

sentences.en: As of Monday night, more than 200 people were unaccounted for in the northern town of Paradise, which was decimated by the campfire that has killed at least 42 people,
sentences.zh: 截至周一晚间，北部天堂镇有200多人下落不明，该镇被营火摧毁，这场火灾已造成至少42人死亡，

sentences.en: burned about 113,000 acres, and is only about
sentences.zh: 烧毁了约113,000英亩土地，目前仅

sentences.en: 25% contained.
sentences.zh: 25%得到控制。

sentences.en: In the south, the Woolsey Fire, west of Los Angeles, has killed two people, charred more than 90,000 acres in communities like Malibu, and is only 20% contained.
sentences.zh: 在南部，洛杉矶以西的伍尔西大火已造成两人死亡，在马里布等社区烧焦了超过90,000英亩土地，目前仅20%得到控制。

sentences.en: The way I would describe it, and I'm going to amend something I said before, this is not the new normal, this is the new abnormal.
sentences.zh: 我会这样描述它，我要修改我之前说的一点，这不是新常态，这是新非常态。

sentences.en: And this new abnormal will continue, certainly in the next
sentences.zh: 而这种新非常态将持续下去，肯定是在接下来的

sentences.en: 10 to 15 to 20 years.
And unfortunately, the best science is telling us that dryness, warmth, drought, all those things, they're going to intensify.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，最好的科学告诉我们，干燥、温暖、干旱，所有这些事情，它们将会加剧。

sentences.en: So we have a real challenge here, threatening our whole way of life.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这里面临一个真正的挑战，威胁着我们的整个生活方式。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争的控制之下。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，和我一起，

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力，却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看。
